title: Tropical cyclone, Bangladesh, 10 May 2023 (TC20230510BGD)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Tropical cyclone, Bangladesh, 10 May 2023 (TC20230510BGD), from 3 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code TC20230510BGD, GDACS Id: 1000970**  This map illustrates satellite-based damage assessment in Saint Martin’s Island Cox’Bazar District, Chattogram Division detected by using a Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 15 May 2023. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT identified 211 affected and potentially affected structures.
Taking into account the pre-building footprints provided by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap, this represents about 17% of the total number of structures affected in Saint Martin’s Island.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).

HDX datasets:

- [Damage assessment in Saint Martin’s Island Cox’Bazar District, Chittagong Division  as of 15 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-saint-martins-island-coxbazar-district-chittagong-division-as-of-15-m)
- [Tropical Cyclone MOCHA 23 - Population Exposure Analysis  in Bangladesh and Myanmar -V2- Issue date: 14 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/tropical-cyclone-mocha-23-population-exposure-analysis-in-bangladesh-and-myanmar-v2-issue-)
- [UNOSAT - Tropical Cyclone MOCHA 23 - Population Exposure Analysis  in Bangladesh and Myanmar -13 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/unosat-tropical-cyclone-mocha-23-population-exposure-analysis-in-bangladesh-and-myanmar-13)
